d: As US immigration politics grows more restrictive, could India turn America’s brain drain into a brain gain? With Indians dominating the H-1B talent pool and India’s Global Capability Centres expanding rapidly, tightening US visa rules may push more students and tech professionals toward India. At the same time, a political row over an all-vegetarian BRICS summit dinner has reignited debate about India’s diverse food culture. What do immigration trends and NFHS data reveal about India’s talent and culinary landscape?
